s: Emotes are short actions that the player character can act out, which will also show the emote over the players head in a thought bubble.
Emotes can be activated by typing it into
using the emote command (/emote ), or by pressing the Emote Menu keybind (Default Y), and on controller Hold Right Thumb Stick.
Blush, Jar, Music and Taunt are hidden from the emote menu until you type them as a command, such as /emote jar in the chat window.
